summary_1line: Khara’s demon army advances on Rama; ominous signs appear, Rama sends Lakshmana and Sita away, and prepares to face fourteen thousand demons alone.

image_candidates.scene_text: Dark clouds rain blood over the forest as Rama points out dreadful omens to Lakshmana before the approaching demon army.
Lakshmana escorts Sita into a hidden mountain cave while Rama stands outside in shining armor, preparing to face the demons alone.
Rama, blazing like fire in golden armor, twangs his bow so loudly that the four directions echo while gods and sages watch from the sky.
